Jean and his son, Michel. Soon after they arrived in Vetheuil, Monet's wife
died, but Monet stayed in Vétheuil with his two boys.
Monet painted a lot of his paintings outside, and he often painted his

to plant flowers where he lived. In the garden in Vétheuil, he planted tall
flowers, and the blue and white flovverpots in the painting were Monet's.

of his paintings. Look closely at the flowerpots. What different colors can
